title: User rules
description: The rules the person set, as the app hands them to the plan engine (planContext, recommendWeek and checkPlan take them as `rules`). Never worked out from data. Where home is stays on the phone and is not part of this value. Every field is optional; a missing one takes its default in recommend-agent/src/rules.mjs.

restWeekdays.description: Weekdays never planned, Monday 0 to Sunday 6.

sessionMinutes.description: How long one home session lasts.

window.description: The earliest and the latest start, as HH:MM on the phone's clock.

mornings.description: True lets a session start from 06:00. Off unless the person turns it on.

equipment.description: What the person has to train with at home. Floor and wall are always there.

movements.description: Movement id to what it is to the person.
